Become a Credentialed Coach with CMA’s ICF Coaching Training Online Program

When it comes to personal and professional development, coaching stands out as one of the most essential tools. No matter you are looking to enhance your leadership skills, make a career shift into coaching, or support others in their growth, becoming an ICF-credentialed coach should be your next move. The International Coaching Federation (ICF) certification is widely recognized as a gold standard in the industry.

As an ICF-certified coach, you unlock the doors to work with individuals and organizations on a global scale. But there’s a defined path you need to follow to go from an aspiring coach to an ICF-certified professional.

If you seriously want to commit to coaching people, the first thing you need to do is sign up for an ICF-approved coaching training course- online or offline.

Coach Masters Academy (CMA) offers ICF coaching training online program that goes beyond traditional learning approaches, providing a transformational experience that focuses on sustainable change.

In this blog, we will guide you through the key steps involved in becoming an ICF-certified coach, and how CMA fulfills the criteria with the unique training approach.

Coach Masters Academy’s Proprietary Transformative Approach

When selecting an ICF certification training course online, you must pick a program that meets the ICF code of ethics while delivering training to create a real impact. Coach Masters Academy has become a leader in the field of coaching and is globally recognized for its proprietary transformative coaching approach.

While other programs teach the foundational aspects of coaching, CMA goes a step ahead by offering coaching training under the Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation framework, which empowers coaches to facilitate deep, sustainable change in their clients.

The Awareness-Clarity-Choice (ACC) conversation framework focuses on helping clients gain greater self-awareness, achieve clarity around their goals, and make conscious choices that lead to positive lasting change. This structured conversation framework is designed to move beyond surface-level coaching and encourage profound insights.

The ability to facilitate such a deep transformation sets CMA-trained coaches apart. With CMA, not only will you be equipped with the skills to guide your clients toward success but also with the mindset and tools to foster enduring change.

Steps to Become an ICF-Certified Coach

Now that you know the benefits of Coach Masters Academy’s transformative approach, let’s look at the steps toward achieving your ICF-coach credential.

1.   Sign Up for an ICF-Approved Coaching Training Program

Your journey begins with selecting the right ICF-approved training program. While there are many available, it’s important to choose one that aligns with your learning style and offers comprehensive training. Coach Masters Academy delivers top-notch ICF coaching training online, where you can receive a high standard of education from experienced instructors. Our online programs are designed to be flexible yet thorough, enabling you to balance your training with other life commitments.

2.   Complete 60+ Hours of Accredited Coach Training

To apply for an Associate Certified Coach (ACC) credential, you need to complete at least 60 hours of accredited coach-specific training. CMA’s ICF Core Training for Professional Coaching program of 70 hours duration meets this requirement while ensuring you are thoroughly prepared for both the practical and theoretical aspects of coaching. Their transformative approach equips you to handle real-world coaching scenarios with confidence.

3.   Engage in 10 Hours of Mentoring

Mentorship is a critical component of ICF certification. You are required to engage in a minimum of 10 hours of mentoring with an experienced ICF-certified coach. This mentorship helps refine your skills, deepen your understanding of core competencies, and receive constructive feedback. CMA integrates mentoring into its training programs, so you can seamlessly meet this requirement while continuing your education.

4.   Log 100 Hours of Coaching Practice

Practical experience is vital for building your coaching skills. As part of the certification process, you will need to log a minimum of 100 hours of coaching practice. CMA provides guidance on how to structure your practice sessions, ensuring that you are not only logging hours but also gaining meaningful experience that will help you grow as a coach.

5.   Apply with the ICF

Once you have completed your training, mentoring, and practice hours, you can submit your application to the ICF. You will need to provide your training certificate, proof of mentoring hours, and your coaching log. After applying, you will take a multiple-choice test that assesses your understanding of ICF’s core competencies. The training provided by CMA ensures that you are well-prepared for this final step.

ICF Coaching Training by Coach Masters Academy

Choosing the right ICF certification training course online can be a daunting task, but Coach Masters Academy simplifies your decision with the unique blend of ICF-accredited training and a transformational coaching approach. With our proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice conversation, you can learn how to create real, lasting change in your clients, which is critical to ensure your success as a coach.

The other factors that make CMA the leader in the coaching fraternity are the faculty members, comprising seasoned professionals with years of experience in coaching and mentoring. Our coaches provide you with invaluable insights and guidance that you remain instrumental throughout your coaching practice. Additionally, with flexible learning options, you can access high-quality ICF coaching training online from anywhere in the world.
